# Razorpay Payments

- Create orders server-side.
- Keep amount and plan mapping server-controlled.
- Verify payment signatures before plan upgrades.
- Use raw request body for webhook verification where required.
- Make webhook processing idempotent.
- Test forged signatures and duplicate webhook events.
